test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

The manuscript will have been translated by the time the expedition returns.

options.text: They will have translated the manuscript by the time the expedition returns.
The expedition will return by the time they translate the manuscript.
Someone will translate the manuscript by the time the expedition returns.
They have translated the manuscript by the time the expedition returns.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. They will have translated the manuscript by the time the expedition returns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and needs to be converted into the active voice.
 
• In active voice, the subject performing the action is explicitly stated.
 
• The structure of the active voice in this sentence is **Subject + will have + past participle + by the time + clause**.
 
• In this case, "They" is the subject performing the action of translating the manuscript.

Correct sentence: *They will have translated the manuscript by the time the expedition returns.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active vs Passive Voice:**

 
 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. Example: "He wrote the book."
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject receives the action. Example: "The book was written by him."
 
 
 
• Passive voice sentences can be converted to active voice by identifying the subject performing the action and restructuring the sentence accordingly.
